contexts.text: The Word of the Old Testament contains arcana of Heaven... AC 4. AC 1408.
These words contain more arcana than can be told at present, although in the sense of the letter nothing of an arcanum appears.
These things, to man, are arcana.
That the Word contains the arcana of regeneration...
The arcana are so many, that volumes would not suffice... AC 1676:2.
If anyone knew how many arcana are contained in each verse, he would be astounded; so many arcana are contained that they could never be uttered... AC 1414.
It is evident that (these words) involve more hidden things. AC 894. AC 940:end.
Here there are two arcana... AC 2715. DLW 221.
For a hidden reason... AC 1756:3.
Each word of this verse involves so many arcana, that they could never be expounded... AC 1904:4. AC 2618. AC 4560. AC 4563:4.
And what is as yet an arcanum...
There is not a syllable, which, in the inward sense, does not involve arcana.
(These things) would not have been worthy of mention in the Word of the Lord, unless these arcana were involved. AC 1834.
In a vision of the night was the secret revealed ().
They who find out the secrets of others with an end of doing injury... AC 5388.
They who do not know the arcana of the Lord's Kingdom...
These arcana are not manifest to man except in the other life.
The sense of the letter... is representative and significative of arcana that no one sees, except the Lord, and the Angels...
Everyone can see that there is a Divine arcanum (contained here). The arcanum is... AC 2075:3. AC 2310:3. AC 2342:3. AC 3952:3. AC 3993. AC 4675. AC 6574. AC 7050.
This is an arcanum not known before... AC 4180:5. AC 6472:end.
The arcanum therein contained is too deeply concealed to be... described in a few words.
Hence it may be evident how great are the arcana in the Word, and how deeply they are concealed. AC 2162. AC 2176. AC 3599:3.
Scientific and sensual things... from which they reason about the arcana of faith... AC 2492:2.
All arcana whatever, yea, the deepest arcana, convey an idea... AC 2249:3.
To the ideas that a man cherishes concerning Divine arcana there always adheres some idea from worldly things...

They seem to themselves to be building small cities, and to hide some secret thing in the midst of them... these cities they give others, with prayers that they will not violate the secret in the midst of them.
From these few words shine forth three arcana to those who are in the inward sense...
These things are too deeply hidden to be described; yea, to be illustrated by anything that is in the world... AC 2643:end. AC 3086:2...
Many arcana would have to be unfolded, before...
A serpent (Dan) = those who reason from sensual and scientific things about Divine arcana.
The arcana of the heavenly marriage are described in (these words). AC 3952:3.
The arcana that treat about these things cannot be easily expounded to the apprehension...

To expound these things one by one... would be to speak mere arcana... But it is sufficient to know that the arcana of that process are here contained in the inward sense; and, in fact, such great and wonderful ones that they cannot be expounded to the apprehension as to the thousandth part.
(The word arcanum occurs.) AC 4149. AC 4162. AC 4249. AC 4264. AC 4266. AC 4295. AC 4379. AC 5006. AC 5583. AC 6371. AC 6516.

Such are the arcana that come before the Angels when these words are being read by man... The Angels are in the most profound arcana, when the man does not even know that there is any arcanum in it. But these things that are mentioned are only a very few, for in these arcana the Angels see and perceive innumerable things; yea, relatively, indefinite ones, which can never be uttered...

There are so many and such great arcana (in nature), that what man knows is hardly anything relatively to what he does not know; how much more must this be the case with the arcana that exist in the... Spiritual world. Enumerated.
These arcana are manifest only to those who are in the light of Heaven, and as to some rough image to those who are in the light of the world, when the light of Heaven is admitted into it.
Into their secret come not thou my soul (). [This is rendered secretum in AC 6351.]
Unless this arcanum be known...
Whoever knows the formation of good from truths, knows the veriest arcana of Heaven; for he knows the arcana of the formation of man anew...
(This) is an arcanum from Heaven, and is for those who will be in the New Jerusalem. TCR 154:end.
(These words signify) that the Lord would reveal the arcana of Heaven. The arcana that are revealed in what now follows are concerning Heaven and Hell...

An Angel... described regeneration, and brought forth arcana concerning it to the number of a hundred in their order, and filled each arcanum with ideas in which there were more interior arcana... He said that he could augment the number of arcana to some thousands...
The laws (of the Divine Providence) are arcana, hitherto stored up in the wisdom with the Angels, but now to be revealed.
This is an arcanum of arcana of angelic wisdom.
Withdrawal from evil is effected by the Lord by a thousand modes, even the most secret. Explained.
This arcanum can only be understood by those who are in wisdom from reception of the light of Heaven from the Lord...
Representatives of the arcana of marriage love... He replied, To us here they are not arcana, and therefore neither are they mystical.
... one other arcanum of marriage love. I replied, Why do you say one, while I have come hither to learn many. They replied, They are arcana...
There is a communion... of certain secrets (between married partners).
Wherefore this great arcanum shall be discovered.
Now it is allowable to enter intellectually into the arcana of faith.
The learned... in the arcana of that faith...
They wanted to ask some things that are more arcane, yea, most arcane; but... it was given to tell them, that I may answer nothing to such [questions]...
[At the word arcana Emanuel Swedenborg gives a cross reference to Mysteria.]

The Lord Jehovah will not do a word without revealing His secret unto His servants the prophets () = that the Lord opens the interior things of the Word and of doctrine to those who are in truths from good.
